intro: Rate each thread on its own, from 1 to 5. Some threads were written by small base models and some by large chat models; nothing says which. Keep 5 rare.

scales.label: Believable
scales.ask: Could real people have written this thread?
scales.high: I'd believe it was real people

scales.label: Interest
scales.ask: Would you keep reading, or want to reply?

scales.label: Deliberate humour
scales.ask: Someone is plainly trying to be funny, and it lands.

scales.label: Deadpan humour
scales.ask: Funny because posters are sincerely, confidently wrong or oblivious, without signalling a joke.

scales.label: Overall
scales.ask: How much would you want this thread on the board?

repost: Would you repost or retell this thread to someone?
